verdict.rationale: FreeAgent documents its own Smart Capture tool, which extracts data from bill images and files and matches and categorises them. That covers the bill-capture step. The pack has no evidence of approval routing or payment scheduling, so the end-to-end AP workflow is unproven. Missing for 10: approval routing for vendor bills, scheduling of bill payments, evidence of a single unified capture-approve-pay workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow

citations.quote: Unlock unlimited use of the Smart Capture tool, which offers automatic data extraction, transaction matching and categorisation for receipt and bill images and files.
